Main article: Cannabis in Eswatini.

'''Cannabis in Eswatini (Swaziland)''' is a traditional crop called '''insangu''' in Swazi. The plant is subject to drug control and remains illegal in almost all cases.

The local traditional plant variety (Cannabis strain) is known as "Swazi gold"; it is often bioprospected and commands a high price due to its reputation for potency,
